intro.v: The people below all want to spend a day on a tourist railway, an old-fashioned railway only used by tourists nowadays. On the opposite page there are eight descriptions of tourist railways. Decide which tourist railway would be the most suitable for the people below.

content.v: Eight fantastic tourist railways

This small railway follows a beautiful route through different types of countryside. There’s a café on the train serving delicious snacks and drinks. Fun quizzes and games are organised for kids and teenagers at the stations, one of which also has a small museum.

Although the museum at Kerry station closed last year, this railway still provides a great day out. Volunteers on board will inform you about interesting things to look out for during the train journey, and there are treasure hunts and music at each stop on the route. There’s a special offer on tickets for parents with children.

Perfect for a special day out, this railway line’s fun for everyone, with cheap family tickets and great-value sandwiches and cakes available on the train and at stations. There’s lots to see from the train, including birds and other animals, if you look carefully. There’s also a lovely hotel next to Amberton station.

Southland station has a great museum with photographs and objects from when this seaside railway was first built right up to the present day. Don’t miss the fantastic film shown there, explaining what the Southland Railway staff do every day at work. There’s also reasonably priced accommodation within a few minutes’ walk.

This route goes through countryside full of birds and wild animals. Before you set off, you’ll get a list of questions about what you’ll see from the train. Answer them all correctly during the journey, and you’ll win a great souvenir of your trip! Staff can even organise cakes and food on board for a special occasion.
This route was made famous in the movie
The Line

, as you’ll certainly hear from the guide on your train. You can even hire the whole train and get the chance to sit next to the driver, for that really special birthday celebration. Interesting souvenirs are available at each station.

During your journey, the scenery will keep on changing – you’ll never get bored! There are stalls at each of the stations – you’ll definitely find something to remember your visit by. Famous for its wonderful restaurant, the Viaduct Hotel at the end of this lovely route is a great place to stay.

This railway runs just a few metres from the sea between Delland and Tarford, so watch carefully for dolphins! You’ll possibly recognise the railway from movies, as it’s appeared in several popular ones. Low-cost tickets are available for parents with children, and you’ll have the chance to buy snacks, drinks and light meals during your journey.

content.v: Why music is important to me
by Amy Walsh, aged 16

I’ve always been creative and by the time I started secondary school, I was already doing loads of music in my free time. In my first year, because I particularly loved singing, I decided to set up a band, and asked some school friends to join. We learnt songs by popular girl bands, and performed them at school events. And for one special concert, we even sold tickets with our signatures on them – in case we ever became famous one day!

But then, in my second year, I gradually started giving up some of my musical activities. I’d like to say it was because my schoolwork became more challenging, but I think it was actually more about me developing different interests. I preferred spending my free time going shopping with classmates, or playing tennis – which to my surprise, I discovered I had a real talent for.

However, after a while, I started missing all the music – especially singing. Joining a singing group seemed like the answer. The one at school already had too many members, though, so I found a small singing group in my town instead. But I had to audition – in other words, sing solo in front of some group members and let them decide whether I was good enough. It was fair, I guess, but I was really nervous. Somehow, though, my performance satisfied them, and I was allowed to join. When they told me, I couldn’t stop smiling!

That was two years ago – and I still love singing with the group. I’ve met some great people, and our shows are amazing, too. I especially love the huge excitement of being in a really great show, with the audience all clapping. There’s really nothing like it! The only thing is that we practise on Thursday evenings – that doesn’t always work well with my schoolwork, so I sometimes miss it.

Singing in the group has also made me want to write my own songs. I found it hard to write good words to go with my music, though. Then I remembered a teacher saying that music takes you to places that words simply can’t reach. So maybe it’s OK just to focus on the music!

content.v: Writing for the school newspaper

Writing articles for your school newspaper can be fun and interesting. You can report on everything from a change in school rules to the results of the school team’s basketball match. There are all kinds of stories waiting to be told.
In fact, the two styles are quite different.

One difference is that, when a journalist is writing their news story, they include all of the basic facts in the first paragraph. Later paragraphs contain the rest of the information in order, from most to least important.

It is sometimes necessary to do this because, when the newspaper is put together, there isn’t enough space for everything. Deleting the last few paragraphs of a story is the easiest way to fit it all in.
A journalist’s responsibility is to report news accurately.

These may include sports scores, the spelling of names and the location of events. Write them down in a notepad, and if you can, record interviews. This will help to ensure that your finished article doesn’t contain mistakes.
News stories must deliver the facts quickly, but as well as informing readers, you need to make your story interesting.

For example, write about what the crowd at an event thought about it. At a sports event, talk to the team captain and include their words in your report. And take plenty of photos to accompany your article.
If your story is about something that different people have different feelings about, make sure that you include everyone’s opinions.
Instead, you have to let readers make up their own minds by reporting both sides of the argument.
When your article is finished, give it a final spelling and grammar check, and add a headline. And don’t forget your name. You want everyone to know who wrote that amazing article!
So, when you’re researching your story, double check the details.
Being a journalist isn’t about telling readers what you think.
Readers don’t enjoy this type of report very much.
But remember that writing a newspaper article isn’t the same as writing fiction.
Ask more experienced writers on the newspaper about them.
